scope: CPU-only bounded local source extraction; no source changes, remote access, NPU use, downloads or repeated EP-GMM ABI audit
status: Reusable synchronization/launch/math components exist; current MegaMoE forward is quantized inference, not an implemented BF16 training fusion pipeline

items.name: launch_and_compute_scope
items.implemented: Implemented MIX(1,2), schedmode1 direct launch; concrete forward instantiations use quantized E4M3 dispatch/FP8 or packedFP4 weights and BF16 output. BF16 input/output does not establish a BF16 dense-training implementation.
items.needs_new_or_validation: New BF16 A/B specialization and backward entry are required; reuse launch shell only after preserving actual block/subcore ratios.

items.name: actual_core_resources
items.implemented: Queries actual AIC/AIV/UB and CalcTschBlockDim; writes aicNum/blockAivNum and blockNumPerEP=max(1,AIC/EP). No source promise that AIC is always32.
items.needs_new_or_validation: For a32-logical-block MIX1:2 launch, plan32 AIC and64 AIV lanes, not32 total workers. Tiling counts, ready-array strides and launched block count must match; verify on actual platform.

items.name: dispatch_ready
items.implemented: Real source/expert range gather drains route batch and MTE copy rings BEFORE MTE3_S fence and AtomicAdd of exact overlapped row counts per expert/tile cacheline.
items.needs_new_or_validation: BF16 transport needs its own byte/scale-free layouts; retain exact expert-source-row mapping and publish only after full data visibility. Existing dispatch storage is1-byte quantized.

items.name: gmm1_wait_and_activation_ready
items.implemented: GMM1 waits ready count == min(tileM, remainingRows). Activation publishes per-M-group counter only after its epilogue returns.
items.needs_new_or_validation: Current epilogue is activation+MX quantization. New training epilogue must round/store BF16 GU before FP32 SwiGLU, then BF16 A before notifying; do not reuse quantized activation storage as BF16.

items.name: gmm2_ready_and_combine
items.implemented: GMM2 waits activation counter target N loops. FIX_S completes output before per-group AtomicAdd or per-AIC monotonic tile sequence publication. Paired AIV waits sequence>=expected, then loads BF16 GM tile and sends it.
items.needs_new_or_validation: BF16 training Z can keep this store-before-ready boundary. TopK multiplication needs exact existing training cast order; dP requires UNWEIGHTED rounded BF16 Z, not combined/weighted output.

items.name: combine_transport_completion
items.implemented: BF16 COMBINE_NO_QUANT uses MTE2_MTE3 event before row send; row-slot reuse and final drain wait MTE3_MTE2. This is local send-buffer completion, distinct from remote rank consumption.
items.needs_new_or_validation: Do not interpret per-tile ready as permission to free global Z/Xe. New gradient consumers must be included before reuse.

items.name: wave_roles_and_launch_end
items.implemented: AIV1 keeps one-wave dispatch lookahead and skips GMM1 schedule while compensating startBlockIdx; AIC computes and AIV0 executes activation. AIV1 is reused for BF16 combine. EndSync drains final GMM1 lane pipeline, then local AIV barrier; output cross-rank handshake precedes Unpermute.
items.needs_new_or_validation: Not a free extra communication-worker pool:32 AIC share64 AIV lanes and existing UB/event IDs. Backward overlap needs explicit roles/dependencies instead of launching dW and reusing those lanes unsafely.

items.name: epoch_and_cross_rank_order
items.implemented: Per-physical-AIV counters advance; peer handshake writes count=prior+1 and waits matching peer count, followed by PipeBarrier/SyncAll. Count arrival tags are checked separately because signal and count data may arrive out of order.
items.needs_new_or_validation: This is ordered launch-level reuse, not a per-chunk ring credit/consumer-ACK allocator for retaining autograd tensors across multiple outstanding forwards.

items.name: count_epoch_payload
items.implemented: Count and arrival epoch share a single write: high8 bits hold (phase&0x7f)|0x80, low24 bits row count. Receiver validates every slot before stripping high bits (token_dispatch.hpp:613-688).
items.needs_new_or_validation: Preserve sender/receiver phase agreement and row<2^24. Additional backward launches or reordered reuse cannot share counters without a deliberate phase/ownership contract.

items.name: flag_reset
items.implemented: Per-launch contiguous flag reset uses WorkspaceInfo-recorded element counts; prefetch also resets independent GMM1 tile-status region. Process waits local MIX barrier before consumers start.
items.needs_new_or_validation: Reset must not race a prior chunk/kernel/backward reader. No durable training-context epoch ownership is currently exported.

items.name: save_tensor_storage
items.implemented: Xe and A buffers are quantized 1-byte+scale allocations. MTE-wave GMM2 Z is BF16[maxOutputSize,H], per-row unique for the full kernel, explicitly not a ring; therefore current AIC does not wait consumer ACK to advance.
items.needs_new_or_validation: Xe/GU/A need new BF16 persistent allocations/store paths. Existing Z can preserve per-invocation BF16 values but workspace is reusable after kernel; saving through backward/multiple forwards needs owned storage or retained slots. A bounded Z ring would require NEW ACK/credit protocol.

items.name: catlass_quantized_adapter
items.implemented: Existing stage adapter reconstructs strided tile views; Fixpipe can store GM or AIV0 UB without splitting. Uses MmadMx and MX scale layouts, L1 256x256x256, L0 256x256x128.
items.needs_new_or_validation: Not directly a BF16 matmul adapter. Reuse interface/view/fence ideas with a separately instantiated regular BF16 PackedTileCopyTla/BlockMmadTla; do not reinterpret FP8/MX buffers.

items.name: existing_bf16_catlass_launch
items.implemented: Current P0 has genuine BF16 A/B, selectable FP32/BF16 C, MmadPingpong BlockMmadTla + PackedTileCopyTla + BasicMatmulTla/DeviceGemm; L1 128x256x256, L0 128x256x64; Row/Column layout selects transposes; launch min(tileCount,requestedCores).
items.needs_new_or_validation: Host whole-GEMM entry is not callable as a device tile producer inside the wave. Embedding its BlockMmadTla requires a device adapter and resource/event ownership. M0=128 differs from wave GMM1_TILE_M=256; ready/epilogue/N-loop counts must be reconciled.

items.name: bf16_swiglu_math
items.implemented: Existing vector helper uses FP32 registers and BF16 output registers; template supports optional topk fusion and clamp modes.
items.needs_new_or_validation: Candidate for forward math only after confirming gate/up layout, BF16 input/output rounding, no topk preweight and clamp disabled. No gradient formula implementation is established by this helper.

required_training_saved_contract: BF16 Xe, BF16 GU before SwiGLU, A=BF16(silu(G.float())*U.float()), unweighted BF16 Z; save actual rounded values or exactly recompute them. Preserve p=0 dP and shared-unweighted semantics. Current inference quantization/gating shortcuts do not establish this contract.
